INDIVIDUALLY AND AS REPRESENTATIVES OF L BAR FAMILY RANCH, LP’S CORRECTION REQUEST

	
COME NOW, Deborah Nobles and Gerald C. Nobles, Jr., Individually and as Representatives of the L Bar Family Ranch, LP., Intervenors (Party Number 625 in SOAH Order No. 30. Item No. 5835) in the above entitled and numbered matter before the Public Utility Commission, and files this Correction Submission pursuant to instructions from the ALJ judges during the Pre-Hearing Conference on June 5, 2026.  This Notice is given that Attachment B in SOAH Order 30 for Party No. 625 to be only affected by only Link M22. Link K51was omitted for Party Number 625 under column header: “All Links that Party is Affected by.”  This column for Party No. 625 should be corrected to show Links M22, K51.   In support of this Response, Intervenors Deborah Nobles, Gerald C. Nobles, Jr., and L Bar Family Ranch LP would respectfully show the following.


I.
WHEREFORE, PREMISES CONSIDERED, Intervenors Deborah Nobles, Gerald C. Nobles, Jr., and L Bar Family Ranch, LP respectfully request that the ALJ take Notice for the Correction to SOAH Order No. 30, Exhibit B, and make such correction as requested prior to the Hearing on the Merits in this matter, and for such other relief to which they are justly entitled.
